exposure: Gestational age at scan (18-20 weeks vs other)
Mode of birth (spontaneous vaginal delivery vs other)
Shear wave speed of the cervix
finding: Lower shear wave speeds at the internal cervical os in mid-pregnancy were correlated with shorter time to delivery and preterm birth.
mod_finding: The correlation between shear wave speed and time until delivery was stronger in women who gave birth spontaneously.
